pages.text: Half of what makes Novus comfortable isn't a tech tree — it's a drawer of small tools, mostly from $(italic)Supplementaries$() and $(italic)Quark$(), that each solve one problem and ask nothing in return. This entry sorts them two ways: the things you $(bold)carry$() (survival), and the things you $(bold)wire$() (redstone).$(br2)None are required. For storage proper see $(l:pack_tackle/backpacks)Backpacks$() and $(l:pack_tackle/quivers)Quivers$(); for finding your way, the $(l:4_wayfaring/compasses)Compasses$().
pages.title: Gadgets

pages.text: $(novus)$(bold)Survival — what you carry.$()$()$(br2)$(bold)Getting around and up.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Rope$() — string it down a shaft and climb it like a ladder; coil it back as you go.$(li)$(bold)Rope Arrow$() — fire one at a ledge to leave a climbable line where you couldn't reach.$(li)$(bold)Slingshot$() — a cheap launch upward, or a way to fling a stack across a gap.$(li)$(bold)Bubble Blower$() — fills space with clinging bubbles; a soft landing, or a slow lift.$(li)$(bold)Cloud in a Bottle$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — pour out a pocket cloud to stand on, then bottle it back up.
pages.title: Getting Around & Up

pages.text: $(bold)Carrying and keeping.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Sack$() — a soft pouch that holds a jumble of items and keeps them when stowed.$(li)$(bold)Lunch Basket$() — food only, but a lot of it; eat straight from the basket.$(li)$(bold)Seed Pouch$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — holds one kind of seed by the stack and plants whole rows in a sweep.$(li)$(bold)Safe$() — a locked chest bound to a $(bold)Key$(); only the keyholder opens it.$(li)$(bold)Lock Block$() and $(bold)Key$() — lock a door or container the same way.$(li)$(bold)Cage$() — scoop up a small mob and carry it home.$(li)$(bold)Jar$() — store cookies, items, or a captured firefly; a comparator reads how full it is.
pages.title: Carrying & Keeping

pages.text: $(bold)Reading, lighting, reckoning.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Flute$() — whistle your tamed pets to your side from across a base.$(li)$(bold)Altimeter$() — held, it reads your exact $(italic)Y$() height — for diamond depth or a level bridge.$(li)$(bold)Torch Arrow$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — shoot light onto a far ledge or down a hole.$(li)$(bold)Abacus$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — a pocket counter for exact building runs.$(li)$(bold)Color Runes$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — recolour an item's enchantment glint at an anvil.$(li)$(bold)Antique Ink$() — write sepia signs and tint globes for an old-map look.
pages.title: Light, Read & Reckon

pages.text: $(bold)Ordnance and traps.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Bomb$() — a thrown, contained blast that clears stone without a creeper's mess.$(li)$(bold)Blue Bomb$() — a gentler cousin that works $(italic)underwater$().$(li)$(bold)Spiky Bomb$() — shrapnel that shreds mobs rather than terrain.$(li)$(bold)Cannon$() and $(bold)Cannonball$() — aim, load powder, and fire; a fixed siege piece.$(li)$(bold)Bamboo Spikes$() — a cheap floor trap; the tipped variant carries a potion's bite.
pages.title: Ordnance & Traps

pages.text: $(bold)Worth keeping on you.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)$(novus)Totem of Holding$()$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — die with one and your dropped items gather on a floating totem at the spot, instead of scattering to despawn. The best insurance in the pack.$(li)$(bold)Bucket of Slime$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — carry a slime without a leash.$(li)$(bold)Ancient Tome$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — upgrades one enchantment a single level past its normal max.$(li)$(bold)Matrix Enchanting$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — reworks the enchanting table into a placement puzzle, so you choose enchants instead of gambling.$(br2)$(italic)This is the useful half of two large mods — open EMI and search $(bold)Supplementaries$() or $(bold)Quark$() for the rest, recipes and all.$()
pages.title: Worth Keeping

pages.text: $(novus)$(bold)Redstone — what you wire.$()$()$(br2)$(bold)Sources and signals.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Crank$() $(italic)(Supplementaries)$() — hand-turn it for a short burst of power; the simplest manual signal.$(li)$(bold)Relayer$() $(italic)(Supplementaries)$() — passes a redstone line straight through a block, tidying tight wiring.$(li)$(bold)Redstone Randomizer$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — splits a pulse to one of two outputs at random.$(li)$(bold)Ender Watcher$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — fires a signal when a player $(italic)looks$() at it.$(li)$(bold)Iron Rod$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — a sturdy pole pistons can shove; handy in moving contraptions.
pages.title: Redstone — Sources & Signals

pages.text: $(bold)Displays, movers, and motion.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Item Shelf$() and $(bold)Crystal Display$() $(italic)(Supplementaries)$() — show an item on the wall; a comparator reads what's there.$(li)$(bold)Notice Board$() — holds and displays a single item or written page.$(li)$(bold)Speaker Block$() — reads a typed message aloud to nearby players when powered.$(li)$(bold)Spring Launcher$() — a redstone jump-pad that flings whatever stands on it.$(li)$(bold)Enderman Head$() — a look-triggered oddity for spooky wiring.$(li)$(bold)Dispenser Minecart$() — a minecart that dispenses as it rolls.
pages.title: Redstone — Displays & Movers

pages.text: $(bold)Moving items.$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Chute$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — a one-block hopper that simply drops items through.$(li)$(bold)Copper Pipe$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — pushes items along a line when pulsed; encased variants hide the run.$(li)$(bold)Gravisand$() $(italic)(Quark)$() — sand that falls $(italic)up$() or down on a redstone signal.$(br2)$(italic)The $(bold)Redstone Catalogue$() covers the pack's full wiring toolkit — More Red, every sensor, the lot; this page is just the gadget-sized pieces.$()
pages.title: Redstone — Moving Items
